title: Three possible crops
alt_text: Three portrait frames contain the same mug and closed book arrangement at different scales and placements: generous margins, a closer crop, and a shifted crop. Pale areas around and between objects mark changing negative shapes.
caption: A frame changes how the mug and book share the page.
